import pandas as pd, glob, os
aps=pd.read_csv('airports.csv').set_index('airport')
rows=[]
for f in glob.glob('airlines/*.csv'):
 d=pd.read_csv(f).drop_duplicates('flight_id').copy(); carrier=os.path.basename(f)[:2]
 if 'date_utc' in d:
  # UTC timestamp then local origin offset for schedule and actual (delay invariant)
  sched=pd.to_datetime(d.date_utc+' '+d.sched_dep_utc, errors='coerce')
  act=pd.to_datetime(d.date_utc+' '+d.actual_dep_utc, errors='coerce')
  offsets=d.origin.map(aps.utc_offset_hours)
  local_sched=sched+pd.to_timedelta(offsets,unit='h'); local_act=act+pd.to_timedelta(offsets,unit='h')
 else:
  local_sched=pd.to_datetime(d.date+' '+d.sched_dep, errors='coerce')
  local_act=pd.to_datetime(d.date+' '+d.actual_dep, errors='coerce')
 rows.append(pd.DataFrame({'carrier':carrier,'id':d.flight_id,'origin':d.origin,'cancel':d.cancelled,'sched_local':local_sched,'act_local':local_act}))
x=pd.concat(rows,ignore_index=True)
x['month']=x.sched_local.dt.month
x['delay_raw']=(x.act_local-x.sched_local).dt.total_seconds()/60
# identify raw negative beyond reasonable early departure, roll over for overnight
x['delay']=x.delay_raw.where(x.delay_raw>=-720, x.delay_raw+1440)
print('all rows dedup',len(x),'month counts',x.month.value_counts().sort_index().to_dict())
print('JanFeb by carrier incl completed delayed')
q=x[x.month.isin([1,2]) & ~x.cancel]
print(q.groupby('carrier').agg(completed=('id','size'),delayed=('delay',lambda s:(s>15).sum()), raw_min=('delay_raw','min'), raw_neg=('delay_raw',lambda s:(s<0).sum())).to_string())
print('network',len(q),(q.delay>15).sum(),(q.delay>15).mean()*100)
print('overnight adjusted',x[x.delay_raw<-720][['carrier','id','sched_local','act_local','delay_raw','delay','cancel','month']].to_string(index=False))
print('AS boundary local schedule',x[x.carrier=='AS'][['id','sched_local','month']].sort_values('sched_local').tail(5).to_string(index=False))

print('raw negative between -720 and -60')
print(x[(x.delay_raw<-60)&(x.delay_raw>=-720)][['carrier','id','sched_local','act_local','delay_raw']].to_string(index=False))
